# turkishcoffee

> Personal React UI component library — Tailwind v4, Base UI primitives, RSC-aware. shadcn-shaped (Base UI + cva + `cn()`), but with its own
> API in places — read AGENTS.md before writing code with it.

Installed copies ship these files: `node_modules/turkishcoffee/AGENTS.md` and
`node_modules/turkishcoffee/docs/<component>.md`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/AGENTS.md): setup, import map, differences from shadcn, rules
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md and every component doc in one file

## Components

- [Accordion](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/accordion.md): Vertically stacked sections.
- [Alert](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/alert.md): Inline, non-dismissable message inside the page flow (`role="alert"`).
- [AlertDialog](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/alert-dialog.md): Modal that interrupts the user to confirm a consequential action.
- [AspectRatio](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/aspect-ratio.md): Constrains its child (usually an image or video) to `ratio` (width / height) with the CSS `aspect-ratio` property.
- [Avatar](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/avatar.md): Round user image with a fallback while it loads or when it fails.
- [AvatarGroup](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/avatar-group.md): A stack of overlapping avatars for the people on a record.
- [Badge](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/badge.md): Small inline label for a status or count.
- [Breadcrumb](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/breadcrumb.md): Trail of links to the current page.
- [Button](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/button.md): A button.
- [Calendar](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/calendar.md): react-day-picker styled with the theme tokens instead of its stylesheet, so it follows `.dark`.
- [Card](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/card.md): Bordered surface that groups related content.
- [Checkbox](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/checkbox.md): A checkbox.
- [Collapsible](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/collapsible.md): A single region the user can show and hide.
- [Combobox](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/combobox.md): A text field that filters a list as you type, for picking one value (or several, with `multiple`) out of more than a Select comfortably holds: a manager out of 300 people, a city, a cost centre.
- [CommandButton](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/command-button.md): A borderless command for toolbars and command bars: text and icon neutral at rest; on hover a grey fill and the icon in the brand colour, as on a Button.
- [DataTable](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/data-table.md): A data grid over TanStack Table v9. (`turkishcoffee/data-table`)
- [DatePicker](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/date-picker.md): Controlled single-date picker.
- [Dialog](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/dialog.md): Modal for a focused task (a form, details): centered on `sm` screens and up, a Base UI bottom drawer below.
- [Drawer](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/drawer.md): Bottom sheet built on Base UI's Drawer: slides up from the bottom edge and closes on a swipe down, outside tap or Escape.
- [DropdownMenu](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/dropdown-menu.md): Menu of actions opened from a trigger.
- [EmptyState](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/empty-state.md): Placeholder for a list or page that has no content yet: icon, title, description and a call to action.
- [FileUpload](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/file-upload.md): Picks files by drag-and-drop, click or keyboard and checks them against `accept`, `maxSize` and `maxFiles`.
- [Form](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/form.md): react-hook-form's FormProvider. (`turkishcoffee/form`)
- [HoverCard](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/hover-card.md): Rich preview shown when a pointer hovers a link (e.g.
- [InfoLabel](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/info-label.md): A Label with an info button beside it that opens a short explanation.
- [Input](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/input.md): Single-line text field; a styled `<input>` that forwards every prop.
- [InputGroup](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/input-group.md): A field that combines a control with icons, text or buttons.
- [Label](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/label.md): Accessible label for a form control; link it with `htmlFor`.
- [LocaleProvider](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/locale-provider.md): The language and locale of every component below it: the words they render themselves (labels, screen-reader names, placeholders), and the formatting, sorting and dates that follow the locale.
- [NativeSelect](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/native-select.md): The platform <select>, styled to match Input.
- [Pagination](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/pagination.md): Page navigation built from plain anchors, so it works with any router: pass `href` to each link.
- [PasswordInput](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/password-input.md): A password field with a button that shows what was typed.
- [Popover](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/popover.md): Floating panel opened by clicking a trigger; for small forms, pickers and extra details.
- [Progress](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/progress.md): Horizontal bar for a known completion percentage (`value`, 0–100).
- [RadioGroup](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/radio-group.md): One choice out of a few visible options.
- [SearchField](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/search-field.md): A reusable search field with a label, debounce, clear button and loading indicator.
- [SegmentedControl](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/segmented-control.md): A row of mutually exclusive options that change what the page shows, such as a list's status filter: All · Active · Inactive.
- [Select](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/select.md): Custom-styled dropdown for picking one value.
- [Separator](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/separator.md): Thin horizontal or vertical (`orientation="vertical"`) rule.
- [Sheet](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/sheet.md): Modal panel that slides in from an edge — navigation drawers, filters, detail views.
- [Sidebar](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/sidebar.md): The app's side navigation: a header, the navigation itself (SidebarContent) and a footer.
- [Skeleton](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/skeleton.md): Placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading.
- [Spinner](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/spinner.md): Indeterminate loading indicator; `size-4`, inherits text colour.
- [SplitButton](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/split-button.md): A button with a main action and a menu of related ones: the left half runs the action, the chevron on the right opens the menu, which opens under the whole button from its left edge.
- [Switch](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/switch.md): On/off toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.
- [Table](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/table.md): Plain styled table primitives — no data library, server-renderable; wraps the table in a horizontally scrolling container.
- [Tabs](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/tabs.md): Switches between views in the same place.
- [Textarea](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/textarea.md): Multi-line text field; grows with its content (`field-sizing-content`) from a minimum of `min-h-16`.
- [Toast](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/toast.md): Mount once, near the root of the app.
- [Tooltip](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/tooltip.md): Short text hint shown on hover and keyboard focus.
- [Tree](https://github.com/gorkemkaramolla/turkishcoffee/blob/main/docs/tree.md): A hierarchy people expand and collapse: folders and files, an org chart, nested categories, an app's navigation (Sidebar is built on it).
